topics.name: Shapeshifters
topics.blurb: Creatures with no fixed form - the largest single ability in the whole bestiary, and the hardest to defend against.

topics.name: Tricksters & Deceivers
topics.blurb: Creatures that beat you with misdirection rather than force - illusion-casters, mimics and things wearing a friendly face.

topics.name: Forest & Wild Places
topics.blurb: The oldest fear in the collection: whatever is in the trees once you are past the edge of the village.

topics.name: Mountains & Caves
topics.blurb: Things that live under stone, or above the treeline where nobody farms.

topics.name: Water Dwellers
topics.blurb: What waits in rivers, lakes and the open sea - drowners, luring singers and things too large to see whole.

topics.name: Night Terrors
topics.blurb: Nocturnal predators and the things blamed for sleep paralysis, blood loss and children who did not come home.

topics.name: Winged & Airborne
topics.blurb: Creatures that get above you - from feathered messengers to things that carry off cattle.

topics.name: Undead & Restless Spirits
topics.blurb: The dead who did not stay dead, and what they want from the living.

topics.name: Guardians & Watchers
topics.blurb: Set to watch a door, a hoard or a boundary - and not to be reasoned with.

topics.name: Giants & Titans
topics.blurb: The oversized - often older than the gods, and usually losing to them.

topics.name: Dragons & Serpents
topics.blurb: The coiled shape that nearly every tradition arrived at independently - hoarder, world-encircler, and the thing heroes are measured against.

topics.name: Hybrid Beasts
topics.blurb: Assembled creatures - part lion, part eagle, part something that should not join to either.
